title: Raw tip
description: One actionable claim extracted from one episode, with who said it and whether a pro stood behind it. One JSON object per line in work/tips/<episode_id>.jsonl. Rules: prompts/extract-tips.md.

speaker_id.description: Registry id from pipeline/config/speakers.yaml, or unknown-<label>.

status.description: pro_stated: a pro said it. endorsed_explicit: a non-pro said it and a pro agreed out loud. endorsed_implicit: a pro was in the conversation and did not object. qualified: a pro added a condition (put it in conditions). refuted: a pro disagreed (the pro's correction is extracted as its own tip). no_pro_present: no pro in the conversation.

evidence.description: Paraphrase of the agreement, condition, or disagreement.

corrected_by_tip_id.description: For refuted: id of the pro's correction tip.

topic.description: Free-ish tag: serve, return, third_shot, transition, dinking, hands_battle, speed_up, reset, lob, overhead, stacking, poaching, singles, footwork, grip, warmup, practice_plan, targets, ...

situation.description: When this applies, in court terms.

cue.description: What you see or feel that triggers it.

why.description: Reason given by the speaker. Null if none given.

common_mistake.description: Only if the speaker named it.

scene_hint.description: Positional facts as stated. Words, not coordinates; card generation turns these into a scene.

formation.description: e.g. all four at the kitchen; serving team at baseline; partner pulled wide

ball_height.description: e.g. at the feet, below the net, net height, above the net

handedness.description: e.g. righty-lefty with backhands in the middle

stated.description: False when you had to assume any of these.

claude_note.description: Claude's own observation. Never shown as a pro's words.
